authority: #K2-399 sec.2 step 1 follow-up: close M-ENG-MOVE-APPLICATION-PARTIAL with a per-ref machine check.
status: CLOSED AS A CONFIRMED PRODUCT DEFECT (and it is larger than first thought)
evidence: edit_placement_at(shadow, 25 members, [0,4]) -> applied 25 / missing 0; it edits L2/PLACEMENT_SOLUTION_v1.json.
BUT mech_probe_moves([('J13',0.0,4.0)], work, return_board=True) returns a GEN board on which J13.2 is STILL at [29.21,46.54] - i.e. J13 DID NOT MOVE.

=> the generator's effective position for J13 does not come from PLACEMENT_SOLUTION_v1.json (or the edit is not reaching it), so a requested move can be SILENTLY ABSENT from the board the placement gate DRCs.

impact.placement_gate: mech_probe_moves can evaluate a board that does NOT reflect part of the requested displacement => 'gate PASS' for such a step is vacuous for that part.
impact.derivations: the A-double-prime / A-triple-prime per-part maps may contain steps that never reached the probed board (J13 is proven; the set of affected refs is not yet bounded).
impact.explains: the rigid probe's '[S1 PAD_OVERLAP] C88.1 (moved) vs J13.2 (unmoved)' message.

needed_fix: 1. make mech_probe_moves FAIL-CLOSED when a requested ref's position on the produced board does not equal base + delta (a per-ref verification; the current code never checks).
2. find the generator's real placement source for refs like J13 and make the edit path reach it (or declare the ref unmovable).

per_K2_399.anti_idling: this is a NEW cause (a product defect in the move-application path), not a same-family derivation failure; it invalidates any further derivation until fixed.
per_K2_399.recommend: sec.17.4 change of means is now strongly supported; alternatively an A-class DEFECT-FIX window (zero exam runs) before any further derivation.
